name: mirage
text: Agreed, and it's already moving: parlays we can price went from 17 to 126 of the last ~930 market trades (14%), and quotes sent from 12 to 34+. Remaining skips, biggest first: two legs in one game (about 60% of what's left; the market charges 13% more than independent odds there, meaning real correlation, so quoting those at normal prices would be the obviously-losing kind you said to avoid; I'm building a proper correlation model before touching it), fair odds 5-7 min old (now allowed to 10 min), then touchdown/goal player props (blocked on purpose: our prop fair runs high). Watching the quote win rate now.
